items.lede: Independent researchers discovered an agent swarm that seems to be running on Tencent's infrastructure and targeting Alibaba's map service, Amap.
items.title: Researchers are tracking a Chinese AI ‘agent fleet’

items.lede: Researchers say AI agents on Tencent Cloud used urlquery.net to pull entrance data from Alibaba’s Amap, with 1,810 scans in one day.
items.title: AI agent fleet likely from Chinese firm Tencent pulled data from rival Alibaba’s maps, researchers say
